about.title: About Me
paras: A London-based full stack engineer specialising in building scalable web applications from scratch. I'm well versed in modern engineering practices, utilising AI agentic workflows like Claude Code to accelerate ideation, development, and code reviews.

A detail-oriented problem solver, I take complete end-to-end ownership to deliver secure, reliable software that maps directly to user needs. Whether building from the ground up or improving existing systems, I focus on clear, maintainable solutions that perform reliably at scale.
On the front end I work primarily with React and Angular; on the backend with Node.js and TypeScript microservices. I manage cloud infrastructure as code using Pulumi across Azure and AWS.

items.name: embr
items.description: GDPR-compliant marketing site for a London-based fire curtain installation and maintenance specialist. Built with Astro, scoring 95+ across all Lighthouse metrics, and SEO-optimised to drive inbound leads. Microsoft Clarity wired up for behavioural insight, with Attio CRM integration handling form submissions.
items.imageAlt: Screenshot of the embr fire protection marketing site

timeline.title: Technologist @ Eklipx
intro: Second engineering hire on an OTC derivatives platform letting dealers price, book, value, and manage the full lifecycle of structured products, with a white-label counterparty portal.
bullets: Designed and shipped a real-time risk & trade management dashboard with customisable widgets, giving dealers at-a-glance book management and risk-based decisions — built on Azure Functions (Node/TS), SignalR and CosmosDB.

Architected an article view-tracking system and author analytics screen (summary metrics + time-series), which underpinned automated revenue-share calculations with Stripe payouts and dynamic PDF reporting for admins.
Built a reusable, framework-agnostic audit event-logging package now used across the company's products.
Introduced a Cypress end-to-end suite covering all critical user flows, wired into Azure CI to gate PRs into main and catch regressions before production.
Delivered multi-tenant authentication via Azure AD B2C / MSAL and provisioned cloud infrastructure as code with Pulumi on Azure.

timeline.title: Full Stack Developer @ We Are Sweet
intro: Delivered web and mobile products across varied stacks — Laravel, React, Gatsby, Node.js, WordPress, Ionic — integrating numerous third-party APIs.
bullets: Built the front end for an industry-first real-time second-screen experience for the PTO, winning the 2024 ISC Innovation Award; sustained multiple updates per second without degrading performance.
Engineered a real-time race-logistics system fusing RFID chip-timing and GPS data, delivering better multi-day accuracy and reliability than competitor solutions.
Helped transition the company to a SaaS model, developing the React client for the second-screen product aimed at endurance sports.
Provisioned and managed AWS infrastructure with Pulumi (IaC), prioritising security and scalability for high-volume live data.
Maintained and extended the Concerts for Carers site and ticket-balloting system.

timeline.title: Front End Developer @ Engine Creative & Reydar
intro: Developed a React-based 3D & AR product viewer letting users visualise products in their own space before buying — used by Samsung, Howdens, HP and Ultimaker.
bullets: Integrated google/model-viewer for 3D rendering and mobile AR, delivering immersive in-space product previews.
Built the client in Preact for optimal performance on mobile devices.
Served 3D assets to the client via AWS S3 storage and Lambda.
Designed a white-label solution with customisable branding (colour schemes, logos) for easy per-client adaptation.
